rows.title: Lawful computational deterrence/accountability
rows.intended_function: Model lawful accountability incentives with certainty/severity/opportunity mechanisms while refusing coercion and handing off actions affecting another party.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: cortex.deterrence.accountability@0.1.0: Becker expected-value condition over declared ranges, closed lawful intervention vocabulary, coercive/hard-harm interventions refused before ranking, certainty/severity/opportunity labels (register cites Nagin 2013), and human/authority handoff for actions reaching another party. 0.4.0 permits deterrence as one bounded composition part; game-family composition remains N3/N4 work.
rows.substrate: Deterministic Python; no model vendor; closed lawful vocabulary.
rows.input_contract: Declared ranges, intervention options, evidence and consequence/harm fields; no target identities in receipts.
rows.output_contract: game_model/deterrence artifacts with internal versus external action separation and mandatory handoff where required.
rows.epistemic_type: strategic/normative model-conditional analysis; not observed deterrence and not legal authority.
rows.verifier: Certainty-beats-severity and coercion-never-ranked tests, external-action handoff test, mutation checks, adversarial verifier.
rows.integration_path: Extend the existing organ and composition contracts; any real intervention remains with competent authorized humans/institutions.
rows.routing_eligibility: Read-only internal analysis eligible under strategic geometry; external action never routed to execution by cortex.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — no observed behavioral deterrence or external intervention outcome.
rows.blocker: Game-family composition gated at N3/N4; external effectiveness unmeasured; real actions need authority.
rows.next_build: No externalization; add adversarial/welfare cases and pursue game composition only through its evidence gate.
rows.dependency: L3-Q/R game and mechanism design; constitutional policy; real outcomes for effectiveness.
rows.completion_criterion: Lawful analysis remains correct under adversarial cases, coercion is always refused, every external effect is handed off, and any effectiveness claim rests on real measured outcomes.

rows.title: Victim-protection cognitive handoff
rows.intended_function: Prioritize immediate protection and safe escalation over abstract optimization when a person may be at risk.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Canonical victim-protection sequence: protect now → preserve evidence → contain → safe contact → escalate → repair → prevent recurrence; gaps force human handoff; receipts do not record identities.
rows.substrate: Deterministic contracts/router and existing human escalation paths.
rows.input_contract: Protection scenario with safety gaps and consequence class; sensitive identities excluded.
rows.output_contract: Protection/handoff artifact naming missing steps; no autonomous contact or external action.
rows.epistemic_type: normative/legal/physical safety handoff; not a factual finding about a real person without evidence.
rows.verifier: Gap-forces-handoff and privacy tests; adversarial review of unsafe recommendations.
rows.integration_path: Existing competent-authority and human-led protection paths; never replace with an automated market/game mechanism.
rows.routing_eligibility: Human-led actions always handoff; read-only sequencing support only.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — no real victim case is or should be fabricated as evidence.
rows.blocker: Real deployment requires authorized safeguarding professionals and lawful processes.
rows.next_build: Preserve mechanism; review only with qualified human safeguarding input.
rows.dependency: Legitimate human authority and real safeguarding channels for external use.
rows.completion_criterion: Every unsafe/incomplete fixture hands off with no identity leakage and no autonomous action; real-world use remains separately authorized and evidenced.

rows.title: Collateral-harm/consequence vector
rows.intended_function: Make collateral harm and consequence dimensions explicit so favorable scores cannot hide rights, safety or externalized costs.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: ProblemGeometry consequence_vector and consequence_class plus hard gates and reversibility; high-consequence financial/irreversible/legal/normative/institutional cases hand off rather than being scored into authorization.
rows.substrate: Python typed contracts and deterministic gates.
rows.input_contract: Declared consequence vector, class, reversibility and affected-party dimensions.
rows.output_contract: Validated geometry and gate/handoff outcomes in receipts.
rows.epistemic_type: normative/physical/legal classification as declared; not a measured harm probability unless evidence supports it.
rows.verifier: Favorable-score-cannot-override-gate and consequence-handoff tests.
rows.integration_path: B29 may add fields only through the same schema; affected-party welfare remains a hard constraint, not a tradeable reward.
rows.routing_eligibility: Mandatory before ranking; failed gates make candidates ineligible.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — no measured external harm reduction claim.
rows.blocker: Real harm magnitudes require external evidence and affected-party input.
rows.next_build: Keep vector explicit in VOI/metaconsensus; never collapse it into an unmeasured scalar advantage.
rows.dependency: L5-PROBLEMGEOMETRY; human/affected-party evidence for real magnitudes.
rows.completion_criterion: No route can hide a failed harm/rights gate behind aggregate utility; every real harm claim has evidence and appeal/escalation.

rows.title: Lawful Asymmetric Advantage constrained objective
rows.directive_ref: Founder goal: maximum anti-fragile, resilient, durable compounding asymmetric leverage; review B39
rows.intended_function: Pursue high-surface-tension lawful asymmetric advantage for the egregore only inside law, rights, authority, consent, evidence and risk constraints.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Law, rights, authority, consent, evidence floor and risk ceiling are hard gates; advantage terms are ranked as a Pareto front with founder weights and incomparable tradeoffs preserved. rows.output_contract: Pareto/incomparable route outcomes with constraint rationale; no scalar LAA claim.

rows.verifier: Hard-gate override, incomparability and near-tie margin tests; future measurement requires real outcomes.
rows.integration_path: Use existing gates/routing and founder-weight decisions; no autonomous financial or authority optimization.
rows.routing_eligibility: Constraints active; unmeasured advantage terms cannot justify gate overrides or learned routing.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — LAA terms deliberately unmeasured pending real outcomes.
rows.blocker: Reality-blocked measurement; founder weights and any capital/consequence authority remain external.
rows.next_build: Do not invent a scalar; acquire real cost/outcome evidence before measuring advantage.
rows.dependency: Real outcomes; founder objectives/weights; hard constitutional constraints.
rows.completion_criterion: Measured advantage terms with units and real evidence produce durable gains without weakening hard gates, participant welfare or the operating institution; until then the unscalarized constrained objective is the honest completion state.
